BiblicalUsage: Chalab is milk, the richness of the herd. Abraham set butter and milk before his guests under the tree, God promised a land flowing with milk and honey, and the spies came back saying the land surely flows with milk and honey.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe milk is the taste of the promise: not bread for the journey only, but richness at the end of it. God does not promise His people bare ground — He promises a land that flows.
